items.title: Jason Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I first joined Marcus’s group in ’94... We did Portraits in Blue... We did a trio record of original music called Time and Circumstance... we did a lot of work.

ctx.x: Was it standards? Or were you playing fusion?

The repertoire for the first gig that I ever did as a leader was – it was standards and covers. We would cover things like – just the usual standards. I can’t remember all of them, but it would be – like for example, we did Two Bass Hit, for instance. We might do a blues or something like Au Privave. Also I remember covering some newer songs, things like Country By Choice by Marcus Roberts, or, what else? There were some other tunes. I’m forgetting what they were, too.
